title: Uni-Mol pre-trained embeddings as a feature block (the one untested representation family)
question: Does a pre-trained 3D Uni-Mol representation, used as a frozen feature block, move the full-base physical reading away from the frozen single-representation anchor 0.6080587938801277 and above the frozen cross-seed endpoint 0.5861142332208197?
hypothesis: An end-to-end 3D network could not be kept alive on this roster, but a pre-trained embedding column block is a different object: the network is frozen, the block is dense, and the frozen XGB head is unchanged. The prior is declared unknown; this is the only representation family that has never been measured on this scoreboard.

arms.reference_lever4: the frozen dense physical block, 13 columns, conformer-average dipole (anchor arm)
arms.plus_unimol: reference_lever4 with the Uni-Mol embedding block appended
arms.unimol_only: the Uni-Mol embedding block alone (control arm)

endpoint: cross-seed mean of the per-seed 10-repeat R2 means, exactly the endpoint W18-P1 defined

decision_rule.promoted_when: plus_unimol minus reference_lever4 clears confirm_bar on the cross-seed mean and the delta stays positive on at least 4 of 5 seeds

blocked_rule: If the runtime or the checkpoint is absent, this lane writes a blocked summary with the measured blocker evidence, claims no reading, promotes nothing, and puts no number into any pool. A blocked lane is not a negative result and must never be quoted as one.
stage_2_contract: probes/artifacts/dielectric_unimol_embedding.csv holds one row per inchikey with columns inchikey, smiles, dim_000..dim_{D-1}. It is built by this same probe with --build-embeddings.
scoreboard_isolation: This lane reports under its own pre-registration on the full-base pool. It adds no shot to the frozen main scoreboard, which stays at baseline 0.4091179943351143 and headline 0.4766400383507876 with 11 cumulative attempts.
forbidden: no Uni-Mol number may be quoted if the runtime was absent
no synthetic, imputed or randomly drawn embedding may stand in for the pre-trained representation
the frozen 0.6080587938801277 / 0.5861142332208197 pair may not be edited by this lane
self_check: the anchor arm must reproduce 0.6080587938801277 at seed 42 to within 1e-09 on the full-base pool, otherwise the probe refuses to report any other reading
